claims.claim: Very clean double plate red redemption available
claims.evidence: The witness only reported a PS4 game case cover for “RED DEAD REDEMPTION II” in plastic; cleanliness of the disc/case and what “double plate” means are not shown.

risks.risk: Disc may be missing or in poor condition (scratches/marks), which affects playability and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo/clip of the disc itself (both sides) and/or a short test video showing the game loading and running on a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: Price as case-only or as untested/unknown disc condition (worst case).

risks.risk: Case may be incomplete (missing manual/insert/cover parts).
risks.proof: Open the case and show all contents inside (front/back inserts, any booklet) in one photo.

risks.risk: Region/edition mismatch could cause issues for local use (region lock/edition differences).
risks.proof: Photo of the back cover/region/edition details (barcode/region code) and any PS4 region markings.

risks.risk: Original vs copy cannot be confirmed from the cover photo; counterfeit copies reduce value and resale confidence.
risks.proof: Photo of the disc label/printing quality and any hologram/serial details; ideally a receipt or proof of purchase.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially non-original/unknown authenticity (worst case).

risks.risk: “Very clean” may refer to the case only; the disc and internal parts may still be dirty or damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the case interior and disc surface condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed clean (worst case).

proof_requests: Show the disc (both sides) in clear close-up photos.
Open the case and show whether the manual/insert is included (all contents).
Show the back cover/region/edition details (barcode/region code).
Show disc label/hologram/serial details to support original vs copy.
If possible, send a short clip of the game being tested on a PS4 (loading into the menu).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a PS4 game case for Red Dead Redemption II, so it can be priced at its worst case; key value factors (disc condition, completeness, region, authenticity) are not shown, so the price should assume the least favorable scenario until proof is provided.
